parameters.tables: 2020 Basic Tables Vol 1 T3.5 (pp. 62-65); 2009 Basic Tables Vol 1 T3.5 (pp. 34-35); 2020 Analytical Report Vol 2 T30, T31
parameters.derived: 2020 provinces including urban municipalities (Shefa+Port Vila, Sanma+Luganville)

source.provider: Vanuatu Bureau of Statistics (VBoS) / Vanuatu National Statistics Office (VNSO), via SPC Digital Library
source.licence: no explicit licence on Basic Tables volumes; 2020 Analytical Report authorises research/educational reproduction with acknowledgement of SPC and VBoS. JB reviewed and signed off the attributed-use position 2026-07-04: publication as attributed map products (VBoS & SPC credited on the map and in this manifest) is approved; any redistribution beyond that returns for review.
source.citation: Vanuatu Bureau of Statistics (2022). 2020 National Population and Housing Census, Basic Tables Volume 1; Vanuatu National Statistics Office (2011). 2009 National Population and Housing Census, Basic Tables Volume 1.

durable_files.notes: 2020 T3.5: nation, urban/rural, 2 municipalities, 6 provinces (rural), 64 area councils; 14 categories + total. Published cells carry +/-1-2 internal inconsistencies (perturbation); verified against the PDF text layer.
2009 T3.5: nation, urban/rural, 2 municipalities, 6 provinces (incl urban), 64 islands; 12 categories + total. All rows sum exactly to stated totals.
Project derivation: 2020 provinces restored to the 2009 basis (Shefa+Port Vila, Sanma+Luganville). Reproduces published T31 shares within 0.05pp on 77 of 78 cells.

National religion series 1989-2020 from 2020 Analytical Report T30, corroborated against 2009 Analytical Report T33. Province-level 1989/1999 exists in print only (VBoS Port Vila, SPC Noumea, NLA Canberra).
Published provincial percentages used as the independent cross-check.

Full provenance for the source PDFs: URLs, retrieval dates, publishers, licence statements, SHA-256 hashes. The PDFs sit git-ignored at data/raw/vu_census/ (56 MB); durable archival location is a maintainer decision.

derived_outputs.notes: Provinces 2009+2020; 2020 includes urban municipalities by derivation. Stated-response denominator (total minus refusals and not-stated), matching the NZ product basis.

Area councils + urban municipalities 2020 (65 of 65 boundary units matched). 2009 stays pending at this level (published by island). Torres area council is absent from geoBoundaries ADM2, so its 2020 counts are unmapped at this level.

checks: 2009: all 75 geographies sum exactly to stated totals
2020: +/-1-2 internal inconsistencies documented as source perturbation, verified against PDF text layer and identical in VBoS Version 2
derived 2020 province shares reproduce published T31 within 0.1pp on all no-religion cells
adm1 2020 population sum 293,536 vs national stated denominator 293,535 (+/-1 perturbation)
